The '''Yushan sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] that was located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in this sector included [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]].
